Without arguments the tray starts in the current desktop session (one instance per user).
It shows agent status, runs audits through the agent, sends native notifications and opens a dedicated consent window. Closing it does not stop the agent.
`autostart` manages login startup for the current user (no administrator rights).

REQ-001.name: Software updates
REQ-001.description: Checks whether updates are available for installed packages.

REQ-002.name: Antivirus protection
REQ-002.description: Checks that a supported antivirus (providers: ClamAV, Microsoft Defender, Bitdefender GravityZone, Windows Security Center) is active with up-to-date signatures. With an empty acceptedProviders one compliant provider is enough; listed providers become mandatory.

REQ-003.name: Firewall protection
REQ-003.description: Checks that UFW, firewalld, or nftables provides active filtering evidence.

REQ-004.name: DNS filtering
REQ-004.description: Checks that dnsmasq filters DNS or that /etc/hosts contains a complete, current HaGeZi list.

REQ-005.name: Corporate VPN
REQ-005.description: Checks the connection state of supported Cato and WireGuard VPN clients.

REQ-006.name: Data encryption
REQ-006.description: Detects supported encryption methods: LUKS and eCryptfs.

REQ-008.name: Password security
REQ-008.description: Checks expiry, length, and minimum character variety for local account passwords.

REQ-009.name: Boot security
REQ-009.description: Checks platform protections that contribute to secure boot.

cli_help:
BaradWatchU Client {version}

Usage:
  baradwatchu-agent refresh
  baradwatchu-agent list [--json]
  baradwatchu-agent enable ID | disable ID
  baradwatchu-agent priority ID HIGHEST|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW|OPTIONAL
  baradwatchu-agent configure ID JSON_OBJECT
  baradwatchu-agent check ID [--log]
  baradwatchu-agent audit [--json] [--notify] [--log]
  baradwatchu-agent status [--json]
  baradwatchu-agent history [--json]
  baradwatchu-agent history delete STAMP | history clear --yes
  baradwatchu-agent report-theme list | report-theme use ID
  baradwatchu-agent custom accept ID | custom remove ID
  baradwatchu-agent dashboard [--no-browser] [--open ROUTE]
  baradwatchu-agent notifications [--json]
  baradwatchu-agent events --json [--after ID]
  baradwatchu-agent consent simulate|list|accept|reject …
  baradwatchu-agent --version

Custom checks live in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/baradwatchu/custom-checks/CUSTOM-*/ (configuration.json + tool). `custom accept` pins the tool SHA-256 after an intentional edit. Reports are stored locally in audit history; `history delete` removes one audit and its report, log and PDF, while `history clear --yes` removes all of them. Audits do not require the dashboard or Server. REQ-001 may contact Arch mirrors via checkupdates. Tools run as the current user. The optional tray provides desktop notifications and the consent window; requests are local simulations, and only an explicit acceptance authorizes one request.
